country: United States/North America (large North American university)

links.outcome: Depression and anxiety symptom trajectories over 6 weeks, AI platform versus care-as-usual, randomized
links.effect: Condition × time for depression β = −0.03 (95% CI −0.05 to −0.01; P = .006) and anxiety β = −0.04 (95% CI −0.06 to −0.01; P = .001), favoring treatment.
links.quote: Symptom trajectories were more favorable in treatment (vs control) for depression (condition × time: β = −0.03; 95% CI, −0.05 to −0.01; P = .006) and anxiety (β = −0.04; 95% CI, −0.06 to −0.01; P = .001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the clinical efficacy of a generative AI-powered mental health platform (Flourish) in a randomized controlled trial among college students, testing tool effectiveness rather than a deployment guardrail or practice.
